repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Mechanism evidence · area ux-2 · 2026-11-19T16:08Z
From the #35535 dev's delay probe (os-dev-report 7014659717, built console, list page cold): with `meta/view?object=` held 1.5 s, the first `data/showcase_task` read left at 2562 ms, the view answered at 3608 ms, and a second, identical data read left at 3664 ms. So a view answer landing after the first data read is one trigger of the duplicate. PR #35579 (view read started with the route) measured the duplicate on 1 of 6 list loads before and 0 of 6 after; it does not remove the trigger itself. Dedupe words: late view refetch, data read after meta/view answer.
